title: Hardware & USB Tethering Manager
summary: USB tethering operations: drivers, setup, failover, toggle, reset, modem mode-switch, and a dedicated Network Interfaces State view.

items.title: Install Drivers (RNDIS / CDC-Ether / NCM)
items.description: Installs the kernel modules OpenWrt needs before a phone can appear as a USB network device. 1 is RNDIS, CDC-Ether and CDC-NCM. 2 is ipheth and usbmuxd. 3 is both plus QMI, MBIM and usb-modeswitch.
items.usage_tip: Each line shows Installed, Partial, or Not Installed. A complete set is skipped so the router does not download it again.

items.title: Setup USB Tethering
items.description: Creates network.wan_usb only when a live USB network device is present (usb0, rndis, ncm, or USB-backed eth). Adds it to the firewall wan zone and brings it up.
items.usage_tip: Install drivers first. If nothing is plugged in, Setup stops and does not write /etc/config/network. Open Network Interfaces State after enabling tethering on the phone.

items.title: Failover & Metrics Configuration
items.description: Lists wan, wan_usb, wan6 and other WAN interfaces with their metrics. Choosing one writes network.<iface>.metric.
items.usage_tip: A lower metric is preferred. Enter on the metric prompt leaves that interface unchanged.

items.title: Toggle Interface Status
items.description: Enables or disables network.wan_usb. Enable runs ifup and reads live status from ubus (UP / DOWN / DISABLED).
items.usage_tip: Create the interface with option 2 before toggling it.

items.title: Restore / Reset USB Stack
items.description: After confirmation, deletes wan_usb from /etc/config/network, uninstalls Android, iOS and modem USB packages, unloads tether modules, and restarts the network service.
items.usage_tip: Enter keeps the current configuration. Yes runs the full cleanup, including opkg remove of the USB driver packages.

items.title: Modem Mode Switch
items.description: Runs usb-modeswitch / usb_modeswitch (and usb_modeswitch_dispatcher when present) to move USB modems out of storage mode.
items.usage_tip: If usb-modeswitch is missing, run opkg install usb-modeswitch or install USB drivers from option 1.

items.title: Network Interfaces State
items.description: Full-screen list of every UCI network interface (lan, wan, wan6, wan_usb, …) with device, protocol, live ubus status and metric.
items.usage_tip: Enter returns to the Hardware menu. Status is 🟢 UP (with IP), 🔴 DOWN, or ⚠️ DISABLED.

items.title: System Resources
items.usage_tip: RAM and flash figures come from the live router.

items.title: Back to Main Menu
items.usage_tip: Nothing is changed by leaving this menu.

items.title: Quit DayPass
items.description: Ends the DayPass session from any menu.
items.usage_tip: Ctrl+C does the same and restores the terminal.

items.title: Help
items.description: Opens the manual of the current screen.
items.usage_tip: Enter or 0 inside a manual returns to the screen you came from; q quits DayPass.
